The solution is not a workaround, but rather a base-layer infrastructure that gives creators full control over their online stores and payment processing.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

The current state of digital commerce infrastructure is characterized by high fees and restrictive payment gateways. Platforms like Gumroad charge up to 10% on every sale, leaving creators with limited revenue. In contrast, a sovereign digital commerce stack built with NOWPayments, Cloudflare Workers, and GitHub Pages offers a fee structure of 0.5%, making it an attractive option for digital creators who want to maximize their earnings. This architecture also allows creators to retain full ownership of their products and payment processing, eliminating the risk of being locked out of their own online stores.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure stack consists of three key components: NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, Cloudflare Workers for automated delivery and backend logic, and GitHub Pages for hosting. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments verifies the payment on-chain and triggers a Cloudflare Worker to automate delivery of the digital product. This setup allows creators to focus on producing high-quality content without worrying about payment processing and delivery.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure solution is designed for digital creators who want to sell digital products online without relying on traditional payment platforms. Whether you're an artist selling beats, a writer selling ebooks, or a designer selling templates, this sovereign digital commerce stack provides a cost-effective and scalable solution for your online store. By using this architecture, you can overcome platform restrictions and fees, and focus on building a loyal customer base.
A sovereign digital commerce stack using NOWPayments, Cloudflare Workers, and GitHub Pages can retain up to 92% more revenue compared to traditional payment platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
A sovereign digital commerce stack provides a cost-effective and scalable solution for digital creators who want to sell digital products online without relying on traditional payment platforms.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for a more comprehensive solution to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, check out the Complete Builder Kit ($197) – a bundle of all 6 blueprints and 7 templates worth $348 separately. You can also explore other products and services at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

The fee structure is 0.5% of every sale, making it an attractive option for digital creators who want to maximize their earnings.
Can I sell digital products on multiple platforms using a sovereign digital commerce stack?
Yes, you can sell digital products on multiple platforms using a sovereign digital commerce stack, as long as you have the necessary infrastructure in place.

You can integrate your online store with NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers by following the provided documentation and APIs.
Can I use a sovereign digital commerce stack for physical product sales?
No, a sovereign digital commerce stack is designed for digital product sales only.
How do I scale my online store using a sovereign digital commerce stack?
You can scale your online store by adding more products, increasing your customer base, and exploring new revenue streams.
